lines: 只要你还在呼吸
你就仍然拥有机会
我并不是什么特殊的人
也不是因为我是被选中的人
我只是拒绝放弃自己

line_sources.original_excerpt: if you're breathing right now
you have a shot at life

lines: 当人生跌到谷底
当一切看起来都在崩塌
那也可能是在提醒你
旧的生活需要离开
新的事物才有空间进来

line_sources.original_excerpt: I am at rock bottom
my life is literally falling apart
is literally the sign
you need to be able to let go of a life
make space for those new things to come in

lines: 进入下一段人生以前
先问清楚自己为什么而做
当我开始做社交媒体
我的理由是帮助家人
这个理由让我一直坚持

line_sources.original_excerpt: when you're entering a new timeline
be really clear for yourself is why
when I started out doing social media
my reason why was helping my family
the thing that kept me going constantly

lines: 小心你每天反复想什么
也要留意自己在摄入什么
你摄入的那些内容
会影响你成为怎样的人
对进入身心的东西保持清醒

line_sources.original_excerpt: what you ruminate on and what you think about
become intentional about what you consume
what you consume
is who you are
be mindful about what I put inside of my mind and body

lines: 你不必同时解决所有问题
只选择一件最重要的事
先把注意力放在它上面
因为问题太多又太大时
大脑反而会什么都不做

line_sources.original_excerpt: you just fix all of those problems by focusing on one thing
choose one thing that you focus on
when you focus on that one thing
the problems are too big and it's overwhelming
brain doesn't want to do anything

lines: 当你真正开始行动
开始兑现对自己的承诺
你会发现自己更爱自己
也会变得更有自信
因为你真的做到了

line_sources.original_excerpt: you start working out
I actually did what I said I was going to do
you love yourself more
I'm so confident
I actually did what I said I was going to do

lines: 如果你从今天开始
未来会变得更好
可如果今天什么都不做
未来也不会发生什么
什么都不会改变

line_sources.original_excerpt: If you start today
your future will look beautiful
if you do nothing today
nothing is going to happen in the future
Nothing is going to change

lines: 你会在生命里失去很多
我也失去过很多人
但你唯一不能失去的人
是你自己
只要你还在，每天都有机会

line_sources.original_excerpt: you're going to lose so many things in life
I've lost a lot of people in my life
one person you cannot afford to lose
is yourself
Every day a chance to make it in life
